marker_future: "eftir" + ACCUSATIVE is the offset forward: "Ég kem eftir tíu mínútur"
(I'll be there in ten minutes).  Source: en.wiktionary.org, https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/eftir.
marker_in: The locative-time prepositions that open a bare relative period: "í" +
dative ("í þessari viku" -- this week) and "á" ("á morgun").  Sources:
marker_last: "síðastliðinn" (last, previous), glossed for a repeating period of
"síðastur" (last, most recent), the superlative of "síðari".  The weak
forms are the ones an oblique relative period uses -- "á síðasta ári",
"í síðasta mánuði" (weak dative singular), "í síðustu viku" (weak
feminine oblique singular).  The bare neuter "síðast" is left out: as a
standalone token it is the ordinary adverb "last, most recently".
